GOLDEN HOUR HIGH-ALTITUDE — low-angle amber sun raking from dead west across hull-tops, long copper shadows trailing eastward down the cloud-deck surface, every rivet and panel seam reading sharp in warm sidelight.
DAWN ABOVE CLOUD-DECK — cold Prussian-blue ambient wrapping the hull underside while first orange sunrise light touches only upper hull surfaces, cloud-deck below flushing pink from the horizon line.

STORM-CELL LIGHTNING FLASH — pre-storm charcoal sky with actinic-white forked lightning discharging between anvil clouds, skyship briefly exposed in hard white silhouette, zero detail in shadow between flashes.

DUSK BLOOD-RED HORIZON — sun at the horizon bleeds deep crimson laterally across the entire sky canvas, ship profile edge-lit in burning red, shadow side falling into pure black, cloud-deck below scorched orange.

NIGHT ENGINE-GLOW PRIMARY — cold steel-blue moonlight as base ambient, ship's own thruster-cores throwing amber cones forward, cyan running-lights striping the hull underside, deep cobalt open sky surrounding.

SUNSET PURPLE-GOLD GRADIENT — zenith sky deep violet transitioning to molten gold at the horizon, skyship backlit edge-amber along every fin and gun-arm, cloud-deck below saturated in warm gold from the horizon side.

AURORA EM-WARFARE INTERFERENCE — high-altitude electromagnetic warfare curtains the sky in flickering green and violet ribbons, aurora-pulse reflecting faintly off the skyship's upper hull panels in shifting cold color.

MUZZLE-FLASH WEAPONS-DISCHARGE — primary cannon fires forward into storm darkness, each discharge throwing a sharp yellow-white strobe illuminating hull plating and cloud faces, deep black returning between firing beats.

ATMOSPHERIC RE-ENTRY THERMAL BURN — white-hot plasma shield at the prow provides all primary illumination, hull glowing orange-white from heat friction, burn-trail streaking upper sky behind the ship in incandescent amber.

NEON-CYBERPUNK CITY-GLOW UPLIGHT — low-altitude night pass over a megacity, magenta and cyan sign-arrays below throwing hard upward light onto the ship's underside hull, shadow edges pointing straight up.

ORBITAL TWILIGHT TERMINATOR — high-altitude at the day-night boundary, port hull half bathed in direct gold sunlight, starboard hull half in deep cobalt orbital shadow, atmospheric limb glowing blue at the horizon.

DAWN ABOVE THE CLOUD-DECK — cold blue ambient pressing down from zenith, first orange sunrise touching only the topmost hull surfaces and upper fin edges, cloud-deck below blushing pink, dual-temperature color split sharp.

NIGHT WITH ENGINE-GLOW + RUNNING-LIGHTS — cold cobalt moonlight as base ambient, twin engine nacelles throwing amber-orange fan-light across lower hull, cyan docking-strip running-lights defining the ship's outline in darkness.
